entry.title: New: Bill 45 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, APPENDIX A, PART I, DEPARTMENT OF THE PROSECUTING ATTORNEY, OFFICE FOR VICTIMS OF CRIME" The purpose of this bill is to add a new grant appropriation entitled "Office for Victims of Crime (OVC)" in the amount of $5,000.

View on the council site
